positions.title: Analyst, Cyber Security
positions.description: Security analyst with a focus in application and cloud security.

positions.title: Systems Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for product specific application support for client application

Respond to client production needs by evaluating requests via tickets, emails, and chats at a rate of 5-8 per day

Participate and assist with daily calls with client business teams, acting as a liaison between the business and development teams

Run reports as requested for business teams

Troubleshoot and resolve issues in testing environment prior to deployment

Complete minor code fixes as it relates to recurring production problems on the client application

Implement the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) in day to day activities

positions.title: Systems Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for product-enablement development

Developed using JavaScript ​via​ ConceptWave and Oracle SQL for Customer-Premises Equipment (CPE) product for the Quote to Ordering sales application

Acted as the Lead developer for CPE related tasks in the SalesBot for the sales application, using Kore.ai
technology

Assisted in troubleshooting CPE related issues in the sales application

Implemented the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) in day to day activities

positions.title: Information Technology-Security Intern
positions.description:
Worked with senior employees on the Verizon Intern Business Challenge

Completed penetration testing using the Behavior Driven Development framework

Automated 88 use cases from the OWASP testing guide to run against Verizon applications using Selenium and Cucumber softwares along with Java in an agile environment

positions.title: Corporate Applications Co-Op
positions.description:
Worked with development team for 12 weeks, focusing on simplifying the online self-service application for JEA.com users 

Introduced to Microsoft Visual Studio and ASP.NET, while also using HTML5 and CSS

positions.title: Undergraduate Student Researcher
positions.description:
"Hacked: A Qualitative Analysis of Media Coverage of the Sony Breach"

• One of 25 students selected to participate in a four week long introductory institute for special topic workshops, professional development, research design and programming modules, and forming research teams to design a yearlong research project

• Presented at iConference 2016

• Published in iConference 2016 Proceedings
